# oauth2-provider dcr

Manage OAuth2 dynamic client registration (RFC 7591)

## Usage

```console
coder oauth2-provider dcr
```

## Subcommands

| Name                                                     | Purpose                                    |
|----------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| [<code>enable</code>](./oauth2-provider_dcr_enable.md)   | Enable OAuth2 dynamic client registration  |
| [<code>disable</code>](./oauth2-provider_dcr_disable.md) | Disable OAuth2 dynamic client registration |
